Frequently Asked Questions

Expert guidance on Commercial Fit-Out in Abu Dhabi.

Answers to common project and execution questions from our UAE site engineering team.

Does NASAQ deliver commercial interior implementation in Abu Dhabi?

Yes. NASAQ delivers commercial fit-out works adhering strictly to client drawings, BOQ parameters, and agreed completion milestones.

How do you manage shopping mall work permits and night shift requirements?

We manage mall logistics end-to-end, including gate passes, security deposits, hot-work permits, and night execution according to mall management criteria.

What standards do you apply for high-traffic retail wall and ceiling finishes?

We utilize impact-resistant plasterboard, reinforced corner beads, and commercial-grade washable coatings built to withstand heavy daily visitor traffic.
